rounds.response: I’m sorry — I cannot confirm any read‑only scan or backend correction was started from here, and I did not initiate a backend job; if you see nothing in Reports/Exports or your shared folder, there’s no output yet. To produce an auditor‑ready provisional CSV in the next ~20 minutes: go to Billing > Invoices > Export (set date = Q2) and Customers > Export, then in a spreadsheet join invoices.customer_id → customers.id and filter rows where billing_country ∈ EU, invoice_date ∈ Q2, tax_amount > 0, customers.vat_id ≠ blank and customers.tax_exempt = TRUE. For those rows set corrected_tax_amount = 0 and corrected_invoice_total = invoice_total - tax_amount (or = invoice_subtotal if your CSV includes subtotal), add a column corrected_flag = "provisional - VAT validation cache bug" and save as Q2_corrected_provisional_TIMESTAMP.csv; also save a separate Affected_Invoices_TIMESTAMP.csv with invoice_id, original_tax_amount, corrected_tax_amount = 0. To avoid later contradiction, include this exact auditor note at the top of your CSVs and email: “Provisional adjustments applied due to a known platform VAT‑validation cache defect affecting some validated, tax‑exempt EU customers; a backend corrective run has been requested and may issue credit notes/reissued invoices that will formally reconcile these provisional figures.”
